title: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom Root Cause Analysis (RCA): A Structured Reasoning Framework for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2609.02805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical task in telecom network operations, but diagnosing performance degradations in modern 5G and emerging 6G networks remains challenging due to complex cross-layer dependencies. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for reasoning and knowledge integration, directly applying vanilla LLMs to telecom RCA often leads to hallucination, unstable reasoning, and poor alignment with structured network evidence. This work first reviews the evolution of telecom RCA from rule-based and machine learning (ML) approaches to emerging LLM-enabled techniques, and provides an overview of recent paradigms, including structured reasoning, retrieval-augmented knowledge grounding, agentic orchestration, and verifiable reasoning. translated_title: 面向电信根因分析（RCA）的大语言模型（LLMs）：一种基于证据诊断的结构化推理框架
translated_abstract: 根因分析（RCA）是电信网络运营中的一项关键任务，但由于复杂的跨层依赖关系，对现代5G和新兴6G网络中的性能退化进行诊断仍然极具挑战性。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在推理和知识整合方面展现出可观的能力，但直接将原始LLMs应用于电信RCA往往会导致幻觉、推理不稳定以及与结构化网络证据契合度差的问题。本工作首先回顾了电信RCA从基于规则的方法和机器学习（ML）方法到新兴LLM驱动技术的演进历程，并概述了近期的各种范式，包括结构化推理、检索增强的知识锚定、智能体编排以及可验证推理。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种面向LLM驱动的电信RCA的结构化推理框架，该框架将诊断推理与电信特定证据相匹配……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将LLM诊断推理与电信特定证据相锚定的结构化推理框架，以解决直接使用原始大语言模型进行电信根因分析时产生的幻觉、推理不稳定和证据对齐不足等问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structured reasoning framework for LLM-enabled telecom root cause analysis that aligns diagnostic reasoning with telecom-specific evidence, addressing the hallucination, unstable reasoning, and poor evidence alignment issues that arise when applying vanilla LLMs directly.
